summary: Verified fix for FUTURES OPEN order_id=None bug. Ran mocked test_binance_futures.py (10/10 pass), full mocked regression suite (31/31 pass across 6 files), directly validated _extract_order_id helper for all 5 shapes including orderId=0 -> '0' and empty dict -> None, and confirmed live /api/futures/diagnose returns HTTP 200 with base=fapi1.binance.com, positionMode=one-way, openPositions=[].

FastAPI on_event startup/shutdown is deprecated; migrate to lifespan handlers (warning in test output, not blocking).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Order-id extraction fix verified via mocked tests + direct helper call + live diagnose. Mocked suite: test_binance_futures.py (10), test_sim_binance_leverage.py, test_desync_reconcile.py, test_trailing_native_sync.py, test_bigtime_fixes.py, test_hl_tpsl_none.py — total 31 pass. Do NOT run full /app/backend/tests/ dir (older integration tests hit live markets).
rca of the issue: Previous code likely did `order.get('orderId')` only, which returns None for alt-cased 'orderID' or clientOrderId-only responses, and returns 0 (falsy, could be mishandled downstream) when orderId=0. Fix: new _extract_order_id() tries orderId, orderID, clientOrderId in order, treats 0 as valid (returns str('0')), returns None only when truly absent. _fapi_market_open/_close now use this helper and also logger.info the raw response for debugging. All 5 shape cases verified.
